newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs quiet amid contract setting for May.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs quiet amid contract setting for May.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mostly steady to lower in quiet trade on Wednesday as players on setting contracts for May.
"There is a lack of real fundamental news or emotion in the market today. Everyone is trying to set down contracts," said a Houston-based trader.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, remained steadybetween 34.75 cents and 35.00 cents with few deals heard done. Conway, Kansas, was also steady at 35.75/36.00 cents.
The futures market for propane was also quiet.
Ethane prices were slightly lower, with Conway down about 0.50 cent at 15.25/15.50 cents. Belvieu ethane mix was pegged 17.50/18.00, unchanged from Tuesday.
